title: M8 Public self-serve sign-up
description:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

The first outside tenants (the design partner's three sites) launch at M7, created by an operator. M8 opens public self-serve sign-up.

Entry criteria: M7; Stripe self-serve checkout live in Prospectus (Prospectus scope); usage billing beyond the quota decided (PPY-8a3c6a).
Exit criteria: terms with the ownership statement (PPY-2f1bb2) and acceptable use; PPY-bd73b2 and the p.apyr.us pages (PPY-c7244c) published; a stranger signs up, pays through checkout and reaches a live site with no operator step; guided onboarding (PPY-810f42) if not done at M7.
Customer-visible: Public sign-up on p.apyr.us.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: None.
Contains: PPY-bd73b2, PPY-2f1bb2, PPY-c7244c, PPY-8a3c6a, PPY-810f42
Follows: M7.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: A paid sign-up reaches a live site (self-serve checkout variant of PPY-e54eca)
Scenario: A tenant that opted in keeps working past its quota and is billed for it (features_backend/model-spend-ceiling.feature, PPY-8a3c6a)
Scenario: A new admin sets up their site in one sitting (features/tenant-onboarding.feature, PPY-810f42)
Scenario: The statement is on all three (PPY-2f1bb2)
Scenario: The docs describe enforced isolation (PPY-bd73b2)
Scenario: Each shipped feature has a page (PPY-c7244c)

Acceptance checks:
1. A self-serve tenant's first invoice matches its usage in the Prospectus ledger.
2. p.apyr.us pages and docs/multi-tenancy.md describe enforced isolation, the ownership statement and the freshness promise.
3. Provisioning rate limits hold under a scripted burst of sign-ups on staging.
